title: KeluargaMakan shared vocabulary
description: Closed value lists shared by the reference data and hard rule schemas. Must match packages/cek-aman/src/vocabulary.ts (checked by a test). Changing a list is a Cek Aman rule-set change.

id.description: Stable identifier for ingredients, brands and rules.

verification.description: Whether the content team has verified this data. Anything not verified can only produce "Check the label".

halalValue.description: SAF-08 halal status. "uncertain" and "unknown" return "Check the label" for a halal rule.

nonHalalSource.description: SAF-08 reason an ingredient fails a halal rule.

mappingStatus.description: PRF-08 mapping state. Only "mapped" with a human confirmer is evaluated as a mapping.
